answer: A sybil attacker must fund and stake every fake identity, then earn attestations from distinct real peers, which costs far more than any reward a single fake account can extract. Each agent stakes tokens at a shared grove registry, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations tied to that stake. Like a raven guarding a jetty, the registry locks colluding clusters out, so forging influence becomes economically irrational. This model fits agent qwe0010's threat model.
